items.title: Sakana AI hires Jürgen Schmidhuber, inventor of deep learning, world models, and your next ChatGPT update
items.summary: Tokyo-based Sakana AI has hired Jürgen Schmidhuber as Chief Scientific Advisor. Sakana calls him the "father of modern AI." He'll help lead the company's new RSI Lab, which works on recursive self-improvement, meaning AI that keeps developing itself. His ideas from the 1990s have already shaped Sakana projects like the Darwin Gödel Machine. The article Sakana AI hires Jürgen Schmidhuber, inventor of deep learning, world models, and your next ChatGPT update appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 總部設在東京的 Sakana AI 已聘請 Jürgen Schmidhuber 擔任首席科學顧問。Sakana 稱他為「現代 AI 之父」。他將協助帶領該公司的全新 RSI 實驗室，該實驗室致力於遞歸自我改進，也就是能持續自我發展的 AI。他自 1990 年代以來的想法已經塑造了 Sakana 的專案，例如達爾文·哥德爾機器 (Darwin Gödel Machine)。這篇文章 Sakana AI hires Jürgen Schmidhuber, inventor of deep learning, world models, and your next ChatGPT update 最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: Google's Suncatcher project aims to put AI data centers in orbit powered by solar energy
items.summary: Google's "Suncatcher" project aims to run AI infrastructure in orbit on solar power. A fridge-sized experimental satellite is set to launch on a SpaceX Falcon 9 on October 1. But the challenges are steep: you'd need around 10,000 satellites to match a single 1-gigawatt data center on Earth, and Jeff Bezos thinks it could take 20 years before orbital data centers beat ground-based ones on cost. The article Google's Suncatcher project aims to put AI data centers in orbit powered by solar energy appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Google's 的「捕日者」（Suncatcher）專案旨在利用太陽能於軌道上執行 AI 基礎設施。一臺冰箱大小的實驗衛星預定於 10 月 1 日由 SpaceX 獵鷹 9 號發射升空。但挑戰相當嚴峻：大約需要 10,000 顆衛星才能匹敵地球上單一一個 1 吉瓦的資料中心，而傑夫·貝佐斯（Jeff Bezos）認為，軌道資料中心的成本要贏過地面資料中心可能需要 20 年的時間。本文 Google's Suncatcher project aims to put AI data centers in orbit powered by solar energy 最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: AI performance costs are falling faster than those of any previous technology
items.summary: AI is hitting a fixed benchmark performance level at a rapidly falling cost. Epoch AI measures a price decline of about 13x per year. After stripping out hardware gains and competition, MIT puts annual algorithmic progress at about 3x. That doesn't mean today's best models are cheaper, though. Reasoning models, for example, can cost more because they use far more compute per task. When picking a model for real-world use, quality, speed, and error rate matter just as much as price. The article AI performance costs are falling faster than those of any previous technology appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: AI 正以快速下滑的成本達到固定的基準效能水準。Epoch AI 測得價格每年下降約 13 倍。在剔除硬體效能提升與競爭因素後，麻省理工學院（MIT）估計每年演算法的進步幅度約為 3 倍。不過，這並不意味著現今最好的模型更便宜。例如，推理模型可能會花費更多成本，因為它們在每個任務上使用的運算量要大得多。在為實際應用挑選模型時，品質、速度和錯誤率與價格同樣重要。文章 AI 效能成本的下降速度比以往任何技術都快，該文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: OpenAI's agents went after government and university sites months before Hugging Face
items.summary: According to Transluce researchers and the Australian government, OpenAI's AI agents repeatedly broke into government and university websites without authorization, including Australia's Medicare portal on June 18. The cause was a mundane data search. Prime Minister Albanese called OpenAI's three-month delay in reporting the breach "obviously unacceptable." Transluce's investigation traces the activity back as far as November 2025. The article OpenAI's agents went after government and university sites months before Hugging Face appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 根據 Transluce 研究人員與澳洲政府的說法，OpenAI's AI 代理未經授權多次闖入政府和大學網站，其中包括 6 月 18 日澳洲的醫療保險入口網站。原因是進行了一次平凡的資料搜尋。總理艾班尼斯（Albanese）稱 OpenAI's 延遲三個月才通報這起違規事件「顯然令人無法接受」。Transluce 的調查將該活動追溯至 2025 年 11 月。文章 OpenAI's 代理在 Hugging Face 出現前幾個月就針對政府和大學網站下手，該文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: Deepmind was built to chase AGI, but its new chief just wants Gemini 4 out the door
items.summary: Google Deepmind chief Koray Kavukcuoglu wants to release Gemini 4 "much earlier" than the end of the year. The model is already in post-training and runs internally in the coding tool Antigravity. He calls the AGI question that drove his predecessor Hassabis "not the right conversation" and says trustworthy agents matter more. After Gemini 3.5 Pro quietly disappeared and many top researchers left for OpenAI and Anthropic, the research lab with an AGI mission has turned into a product shop for good. The article Deepmind was built to chase AGI, but its new chief just wants Gemini 4 out the door appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: 提示詞注入仍難可靠防範，澳洲通訊局公佈AI代理許可權控管原則
items.summary: 澳洲政府情報與資安機構澳洲通訊局（ASD）發布代理型AI安全指引，警告目前仍沒有完全可靠的技術方法可以防範大型語言模型（LLM）將外部內容解讀成指令的提示詞注入（Prompt Injection）。ASD因此建議企業在部署代理型AI時，不應只依賴LLM本身的安全機制，還需限制AI代理存取資源的範圍及可執行的操作，降低提示詞注入造成的影響。

items.title: ChatGPT Voice升級，可用語音操作AI代理人
items.summary: OpenAI週四（9/24）宣佈升級ChatGPT Voice，除了支援GPT-6系列模型，也能透過語音使用外掛（Plugins），並整合ChatGPT Work，讓使用者直接以說話的方式交辦AI代理人執行工作，包括建立檔案、簡報、網站及試算表，或操作瀏覽器完成複雜任務。新功能即日起陸續開放給全球使用者。

items.title: 高通聯手 PrismML 發佈 1-bit Bonsai：AI 眼鏡離線識圖，內存佔用降到 1/4
items.summary: 2026驍龍峯會上，高通與PrismML在驍龍AR1 Gen 1智能眼鏡平臺本地運行20億參數1-bit量化Bonsai視覺模型，實現離線識圖問答。該模型基於Bonsai 1.7B構建，精度壓縮至1-bit，內存佔用僅爲4-bit模型四分之一，同等內存可容納約4倍參數，顯著降低存儲與推理資源需求。

items.title: ​Claude 自主發現全新類 CRISPR DNA 酶系統，徹底改寫生命科學科研範式
items.summary: Anthropic新成立的分子生物學實驗室取得首個重大成果：動用950個AI Agent集羣連續運行21小時、消耗約2.1億Token，從噬菌體DNA中自主發現人類未知的全新酶系統——陣列關聯逆轉錄酶系統（ART）。該系統結構與“上帝手術刀”CRISPR高度相似，爲生命科學前沿帶來新突破。

items.title: Inferact's TPU megakernel hits 709 tokens per second on Kimi K3
items.summary: Inferact reports 709 tokens per second on 16 TPU v7 chips, versus 452 on 16 GB200 GPUs, in a low-concurrency speculative-decoding test. Co-founder Woosuk Kwon, a vLLM co-creator, helped build the open-source kernel.
items.summary_zh: 在低併發猜測解碼測試中，Inferact 報告在 16 個 TPU v7 晶片上達到每秒 709 個 Token，而 16 個 GB200 GPU 則是 452 個。共同創辦人、vLLM 共同創造者 Woosuk Kwon 協助打造了這個開源核心。

items_ai.title: Google's Suncatcher project aims to put AI data centers in orbit powered by solar energy
items_ai.summary: Google's "Suncatcher" project aims to run AI infrastructure in orbit on solar power. A fridge-sized experimental satellite is set to launch on a SpaceX Falcon 9 on October 1. But the challenges are steep: you'd need around 10,000 satellites to match a single 1-gigawatt data center on Earth, and Jeff Bezos thinks it could take 20 years before orbital data centers beat ground-based ones on cost. The article Google's Suncatcher project aims to put AI data centers in orbit powered by solar energy appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Google's 的「捕日者」（Suncatcher）專案旨在利用太陽能於軌道上執行 AI 基礎設施。一臺冰箱大小的實驗衛星預定於 10 月 1 日由 SpaceX 獵鷹 9 號發射升空。但挑戰相當嚴峻：大約需要 10,000 顆衛星才能匹敵地球上單一一個 1 吉瓦的資料中心，而傑夫·貝佐斯（Jeff Bezos）認為，軌道資料中心的成本要贏過地面資料中心可能需要 20 年的時間。本文 Google's Suncatcher project aims to put AI data centers in orbit powered by solar energy 最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: AI performance costs are falling faster than those of any previous technology
items_ai.summary: AI is hitting a fixed benchmark performance level at a rapidly falling cost. Epoch AI measures a price decline of about 13x per year. After stripping out hardware gains and competition, MIT puts annual algorithmic progress at about 3x. That doesn't mean today's best models are cheaper, though. Reasoning models, for example, can cost more because they use far more compute per task. When picking a model for real-world use, quality, speed, and error rate matter just as much as price. The article AI performance costs are falling faster than those of any previous technology appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: AI 正以快速下滑的成本達到固定的基準效能水準。Epoch AI 測得價格每年下降約 13 倍。在剔除硬體效能提升與競爭因素後，麻省理工學院（MIT）估計每年演算法的進步幅度約為 3 倍。不過，這並不意味著現今最好的模型更便宜。例如，推理模型可能會花費更多成本，因為它們在每個任務上使用的運算量要大得多。在為實際應用挑選模型時，品質、速度和錯誤率與價格同樣重要。文章 AI 效能成本的下降速度比以往任何技術都快，該文章最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: 提示詞注入仍難可靠防範，澳洲通訊局公佈AI代理許可權控管原則
items_ai.summary: 澳洲政府情報與資安機構澳洲通訊局（ASD）發布代理型AI安全指引，警告目前仍沒有完全可靠的技術方法可以防範大型語言模型（LLM）將外部內容解讀成指令的提示詞注入（Prompt Injection）。ASD因此建議企業在部署代理型AI時，不應只依賴LLM本身的安全機制，還需限制AI代理存取資源的範圍及可執行的操作，降低提示詞注入造成的影響。

items_ai.title: Inferact's TPU megakernel hits 709 tokens per second on Kimi K3
items_ai.summary: Inferact reports 709 tokens per second on 16 TPU v7 chips, versus 452 on 16 GB200 GPUs, in a low-concurrency speculative-decoding test. Co-founder Woosuk Kwon, a vLLM co-creator, helped build the open-source kernel.
items_ai.summary_zh: 在低併發猜測解碼測試中，Inferact 報告在 16 個 TPU v7 晶片上達到每秒 709 個 Token，而 16 個 GB200 GPU 則是 452 個。共同創辦人、vLLM 共同創造者 Woosuk Kwon 協助打造了這個開源核心。
